title: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger: Building Valkey-Timeseries
summary: The author’s slides for ValkeyTimeSeries, a Rust module meant as a drop-in replacement for RedisTimeSeries. A short tour of the `TS.*` commands, then what it adds: background expiry of old samples, chained compaction rules, Prometheus-style series selectors, `TS.JOIN` with as-of joins, an inverted label index built from an adaptive radix tree of Roaring bitmaps, parallel queries and string interning for labels. Written by the module’s developer, so it describes plans and strengths rather than trade-offs.
